text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Today is the rehearsal for the mummy
hunt. It seems the students who aren't
working as event
staff are going to play
the role of guests.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
'Kay,
time to get into positions. I haven't seen
Creek since she said she was goin'
to prep her costume... Guess she didn't
make it in time.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
We'll just join up with her later... I'm
kinda worried about her, though. She
hasn't been herself lately. Probably
strugglin' with that no
coddlin' rule...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Tama, Inari... It's on.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Gruhhh! GiVe iT bACk... GivE baCK Da

tReasuRrRrRe!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: EEEEEK! Nooo! Stay away!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Get behind me. It's time for a temporary
retreat.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: O-okay... Captain Oguri!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: What the—"Captain"?! What're they callin' her that for?!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Ha! She's a seasoned hunter now! But
we're not
goin' down without a fight!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
...Okay, so is Oguri on this floor? ...Or
the one
below?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Now! Bang!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Gyah!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Yesss! One down! Nice shot, Captain
Oguri!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Tama... I blew it. It's all up to you now!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
...Can't believe ya ambushed us from
below like
that. It was a close one, but I
barely managed to
dodge.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
This is the end of the road for you too,
Tama. I'll have my sights on your back
the moment you turn
to run. And this
time, I won't miss!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Hehe... Ahahaha! This isn't over yet!
Take a look
behind ya!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Hehehehe. ♪ Fouuund youuu! ♪
"Mummy" is here
for a cuddle! Just come
into my arms and close
your eyes.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Get 'er, Creek! Drag Oguri into an
endless
slumber!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Ngh... Just play dead! Whatever
happens, just
stay still and pretend
you're dead!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: R-right!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Hehe! ♪ There, there. "Mummy" won't
bite, so
you can just sleep tight. ♪

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Oguri, dear? ...Goodness, she's dozed
right off.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: ...Hehe. Tamtam. ♪

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
What's the hold up? Hurry up and take
her outta
commission alr—

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Let's get you changed, Tamtam! I've got
a mummy
costume for you right here.
Don't worry, I'll help
you put it on. ♪

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
I don't need any costume! Hey! Don't
take yer
eyes off Oguri!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Hehehehehehe! ♪ Oh, would you look
at the
time? It's costume o'clock! ♪

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Why're ya comin' after me?! You just
wanna
coddle someone, don'tcha!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Looks like the tables have turned!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Creek! Behind ya! Oguri's back in action!
Catch
her and coddle the life outta her!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: All riiight. ♪ Hehehe, I've got a hug with your name on it, Oguri! Squeeze! ♪

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Ngh! I... messed up...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha! I've had so much practice
makin' snappy comebacks that my
reflexes are super sharp! Not
too
shabby, if I do say so myself!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... You played me like a fiddle... To
think
you'd sic Creek on me like that...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Creek, you were terrifying! Guess that's what happens when ya can't coddle anyone, huh? Still, that was some real mummy energy!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Ya both brought a lot of personality to
yer roles.
No doubt this mummy hunt is
gonna be a
bona-fide success!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Time to end this!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Look out, Creek! ...Yowch!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Tamtam! You took the hit for me?!
B-b-but...
why?!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Sacrificing yourself to save your fellow
mummy...
You're the best friend anyone
could ask for,
Tama.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Ungh,
Tamtam... I'm so sorry. Don't fret...
We'll be
together again soon...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Mummy Tama... Your valor will not be
forgotten.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: ...Do we really need this melodrama?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
All the mummies get wiped out, and the
mummy hunt goes on to receive critical
acclaim for being
such an emotional
haunted house experience.
